what-is-cloud-computing.question: Which statement best describes cloud computing?
options: Renting computing resources over the internet
Buying servers and installing them in your office
Storing files only on your own laptop
what-is-cloud-computing.explanation: Cloud computing means using someone else's computing resources, such as servers, storage and software, over the internet instead of owning them.

what-is-cloud-computing.question: Which pricing idea describes the cloud?
options: Pay a large fee upfront for every server
Pay only for the resources you use
Pay one fixed fee per year, whatever you use
what-is-cloud-computing.explanation: Cloud services are usually consumption-based: you pay for what you use instead of buying hardware upfront.

what-is-cloud-computing.question: What does elasticity mean in the cloud?
options: Resources can scale up or down to match demand
Apps can run in only one location
what-is-cloud-computing.explanation: Elasticity means you can add or remove resources quickly as demand changes, so you are not stuck with too little or too much capacity.

what-is-cloud-computing.question: When you use Azure, who owns and maintains the physical datacenters?
what-is-cloud-computing.explanation: Microsoft builds and runs the datacenters, so you do not need to buy or maintain physical servers.

what-is-cloud-computing.question: Why does global reach matter for cloud apps?
options: It removes the need for security
It lets you place apps close to users around the world
what-is-cloud-computing.explanation: Azure has datacenters in many regions, so you can run your app near your users, which usually means faster responses.

service-models.question: Which service model gives you the most control over the operating system?
service-models.explanation: With IaaS, such as Azure Virtual Machines, you choose and manage the operating system yourself. With PaaS and SaaS, Azure takes that job over.

service-models.question: Azure App Service is an example of which service model?
service-models.explanation: App Service runs your web app on a platform that Azure manages. You only manage the app and its data.

service-models.question: Microsoft 365 is delivered as which service model?
service-models.explanation: Microsoft 365 is finished software you use through a browser or app. The provider manages everything underneath.

service-models.question: In the housing analogy, which model is like booking a hotel room?
service-models.explanation: A hotel room is ready to use and the hotel handles everything else, just like SaaS.

service-models.question: Who is responsible for patching the operating system on an Azure virtual machine?
service-models.explanation: A virtual machine is IaaS, so keeping the operating system updated is your job. This is part of the shared responsibility model.
